The '''Royal Palace''' was the seat of power of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Zornog]], the ruler of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sooma]].<ref name="Lost in Time" />

{{Struct-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Royal Palace first appeared in [[Droids (1986) 4|''Droids'' (1986) 4]], the fourth issue of the [[Star Wars: Droids (1986)|''Star Wars Droids'']] comic series published by [[Star Comics]], an imprint of [[Marvel Comics]],<ref name="Lost in Time" /> which was first published on [[October 1]], [[1986]].<ref name="The Destroyer publication date">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54154/star_wars_droids_1986_4|text=Star Wars: Droids (1986) #4}}</ref>
